assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The symptoms raise concern for underlying atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I47.1.
There is a documented clinical indication note.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.
Authorization status is recorded as missing (precertification/authorization was not obtained prior to service).
The denial does not reflect any lack of medical necessity.
The payer letter requests supporting clinical documentation demonstrating medical necessity.
